[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 330
- Description: SKU component-vs-finished-good discriminator: diagnose, spec, and correct own regression
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/660
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1943
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/661
  
  Details:
  # SKU component-vs-finished-good discriminator
  
  Three merged PRs fixing a recurring class of ledger misreading. Triggered by governor Gary Teh correcting my claim that 169 ceremonial cacao were stranded in Brazil with Matheus Reis.
  
  ## The originating error
  
  I reported "AGL8 holds 169 cacao with Matheus; MAIN shows Matheus 115 + Gary 74 = 189, which does not reconcile with 170." Both halves were wrong, for two independent reasons:
  
  1. **Wrong columns.** I read the AGL8 `Asset`/`Amount`/`Resource Location` block (cols E/F/H) as "the balance." The actual pouches were in the `Liabilities` block (cols I/J): **Kirsten Ritschel - 170**. The governor caught this.
  2. **Wrong asset entirely.** The 115 at Matheus is **empty kraft pouches** - `Ceremonial Cacao Kraft Pouch - 20250219006` @ $0.675 - not cacao. Comparing 189 empty pouches against 170 finished cacao is meaningless: different asset, different unit cost, no reconciliation owed.
  
  The tell was already in hand: AGL8 `Transactions` r196 states "169 empty pouches consumed from Matheus Reis's Main-held packaging stock to produce the 169 finished units" -> 284 - 169 = 115 remaining empties. I read that line and did not connect it.
  
  Correct reconciliation: Kirsten 170 finished = the 169 filled + 1 previously on the origin SKU. Nothing orphaned.
  
  ## Root cause: naming ambiguity, and a missing spec
  
  Identical head nouns denote opposite things:
  
  | String | Price | What it is |
  |---|---|---|
  | `Ceremonial Cacao Kraft Pouch - 20250219006` | $0.675 | empty pouch - component |
  | `8 Ounce Package Kraft Pouch - Ilheus, Brazil 2024` | $6.64 | finished sellable |
  | `Cacao Nibs Kraft Pouch - 20250219006` | $0.675 | empty pouch - component |
  
  "Kraft Pouch" is a noun class, not a product. Content search confirmed `Serializable` appears in 7 context files but ONLY as a QR-generation prerequisite - never as a component-vs-product discriminator. That gap was the real defect.
  
  ## PR #660 (truesight_autopilot, +474)
  
  `app/tools/sku_lookup.py` (pure `classify_row()` + `describe_sku()` Sheets reader), `scripts/describe_sku.py` CLI, `tests/test_sku_lookup.py` (11 tests pinned to verbatim ledger rows). Built with blank `Serializable` -> `component`. This was wrong (see #661).
  
  ## PR #1943 (agentic_ai_context, +165)
  
  `agroverse/SKU_NAMING_COMPONENT_VS_PRODUCT.md` - the missing canonical spec: counter-example table, three-axis decision rule, staging-vs-arrived pair convention, worked failure case, and the documentation that actively caused the error. Verifying against the live sheet while writing this doc exposed that my #660 rule was itself false.
  
  ## PR #661 (truesight_autopilot, +363/-149, 26 tests)
  
  Fixes the regression I introduced. Blank `Serializable` spans BOTH classes:
  
  | Row | Serializable | Price | Reality |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | r113 | blank | $0.675 | empty pouch - component |
  | r15 | blank | $9.45 | `8 Ounce ... - Zurich` - finished, staged |
  | r119 | blank | $8.315 | Oscar ceremonial - finished, staged |
  | r121 | blank | $10.37 | Paulo ceremonial - finished cacao |
  
  Blank means "not a serialization target" - true of an empty pouch AND of an unsuffixed origin line whose arrived counterpart is the serializable one. #660 therefore mislabelled r15, r119, r121: confidently wrong in exactly the way the tool existed to prevent.
  
  Replaced with the three-axis rule: price < ~$1 => component; price > ~$5 => staged-finished; $1-$5 => ambiguous warning; equipment => component; flag FALSE => component; TRUE => serializable; unrecognised => unknown, never promoted to finished. Added `classify_axes()` so each axis is auditable rather than collapsed into one opaque verdict.
  
  Verified on six unambiguous rows:
  ```
  r 113 component        packaging    suffix=False
  r  15 staged_finished  finished     suffix=True
  r 119 staged_finished  finished     suffix=True
  r 121 staged_finished  finished     suffix=True
  r 122 serializable     finished     suffix=True
  ```
  
  ## A correction I must record explicitly
  
  I previously called r121 a `Serializable=''` component and cited it as "independent confirmation" the QR repoint was correct. Right answer, wrong reason. r121 is finished cacao at $10.37. The repoint (35 bags -> Kirsten Ritschel, AWB SKU) was correct because the QRs belonged on the arrived row (r122, TRUE) and because the manager was wrong - not because the origin line was a component. Recording this prevents a lucky conclusion from standing as a validated one.
  
  ## Testing
  
  ```
  ruff check  <3 files>            All checks passed
  ruff format --check <3 files>    3 files already formatted
  pytest -q                        2569 passed, 2 skipped, 4 xfailed, 3 xpassed (78.27s)
  ```
  
  Scoped test file: 26 tests (was 11). Full suite +15 net vs prior 2554.
  
  ## Process notes
  
  My `merge_pr` on #661 was refused with `mergeable_state=unstable` ten seconds after opening - the guardrail correctly blocked a premature merge; the PR merged later via garyjob. Separately, `gh pr checks` returned 403 (PAT lacks status-check scope), so CI state was resolved through direct REST calls. No production deploy, no ledger writes, no money moved.
  
  ## Residual follow-ups
  
  - `BLACK_KING_SHIPMENT_MANIFESTS.md` line 29 still calls the empty-pouch component line "AGL8 ceremonial cacao held by Matheus Reis" - this sentence caused the original misdiagnosis.
  - `OPERATING_INSTRUCTIONS.md` section 5j hard gate pointing at `describe_sku.py` - deferred until the classifier was correct.
  
  ## Why this matters to the mission
  
  Accurate bag-level provenance is the audit trail underpinning 10,000 hectares of Amazon rainforest restoration. A ledger where a $0.675 empty pouch is indistinguishable from finished ceremonial cacao cannot support credible lineage claims to buyers, and a confidently wrong automated tool is worse than no tool.
  
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 550.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
